description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called SessionMenuLabelView, which displays session-related information including tokens, labels, and age text, along with a context bar and disclosure indicator. It also extends EnvironmentValues to include a custom environment key 'menuItemHighlighted'.

classes.name: SessionMenuLabelView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays session information with styling based on highlight state.
